architecture.global_branch: linear 122 to H/2, then one chronological LSTM of width H/2
architecture.local_branch: linear 122 to H/2, then one exact-PC-routed LSTM of width H/2
architecture.fusion: concatenate to H, learned H-to-H linear fusion, tanh
architecture.stateful_training: chronological TBPTT; one global state plus exact-PC local states
decoder_heads: one shared rank-conditioned direct 58-bit modular delta payload

complete_callback_likelihood.factorization: P(ZERO/POSITIVE|h), P(K|h,POSITIVE), and all 58 Bernoulli terms at every real rank
complete_callback_likelihood.selection_count_support: positive counts observed in FIT only
complete_callback_likelihood.final_count_support: positive counts observed in complete original TRAIN only
complete_callback_likelihood.maximum_complete_TRAIN_count: reported as data evidence, never copied as a normal request budget
complete_callback_likelihood.delta_payload_loss: sum of 58 Bernoulli negative log likelihood terms for every real teacher rank
complete_callback_likelihood.loss_normalization: complete likelihood sum divided by callbacks

target_decoder.delta_payload_loss_scope: all 58 bits of every real teacher rank
target_decoder.selection_initialization: zero weights plus add-one-smoothed FIT bit-marginal logit biases
target_decoder.final_initialization: zero weights plus add-one-smoothed complete-TRAIN bit-marginal logit biases
target_decoder.fill_level: FILL_L2 only; no learned fill head
target_decoder.ordered_uniqueness: exact k-best enumeration chooses the highest-probability feasible 58-bit payload at each rank

checkpoint_selection.metric: complete validation NLL per callback, identical terms to training
checkpoint_selection.after_selection: reset seed, reinitialize, and retrain from scratch on complete TRAIN for selected epochs

inference.rule: hurdle argmax, positive count argmax, then exactly K ordered unique targets

parameter_accounting.H: total recurrent width split equally across global and exact-PC-local branches
parameter_accounting.K: number of positive count classes in complete TRAIN

persistent_state_accounting: one global H/2 hidden/cell pair plus one H/2 hidden/cell pair per exact observed PC
